## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

S5.7 lands the C2 depth of both surface
families on S4.10's `hh-web` skeleton and
S4.11's `hh-mcp-lab` C1 catalogue — every new
behaviour rides `hh-embed/1`, no second
operation schema, no far-side authority:

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| C2 web views (V4 editor, V5 launcher, V3 operations/timetravel, V6 frontier/surface/strata/reliability/transfer, V11 experiment/bundle, V12 console) | View assembly is a pure projection of canonical operation responses; navigation + rendering extended for all six view families | `crates/hh-web/src/views.rs` · `crates/hh-web/src/ui.rs` |
| C2 web ops + session mint (AC-R-2.11.2-9) | Closed admission catalogue gains the C2 writes/Lab reads; the session injects `idempotency_key`, `invocation`, `session_id`, responder identity and the surface-minted `registrar`; browser-supplied `idempotency_key`/`invocation`/`attestation` members are stripped — never forwarded | `crates/hh-web/src/ops.rs` · `crates/hh-web/src/session.rs` · `crates/hh-web/tests/ops_c2.rs::c2_write_opens_writer_and_strips_forgery` |
| `HirDiff` apply with human attestation on widening (AC-R-2.11.2-9) | `lab.assembly.apply` carries the minted `registrar`; `attestation` exists only as the human's own act — a widening `authority_delta` without it fails at the registry's own gate | `crates/hh-web/tests/ops_c2.rs::ac9_apply_registrar_minted_and_attestation_gated` |
| Incoherent-fork presentation (AC-R-2.11.2-11) | Fork views resolve incoherence to the nearest coherent fork points — never a guessed merged state | `crates/hh-web/src/views.rs` · `ops_c2::ac11_incoherent_fork_offers_nearest_coherent` |
| MCP C2 tool groups (AC-R-2.11.3-10) | `ToolGroup::{Analysis, Write, Hosting}` + the C2 catalogue entries (`analyze`, `render`, `diff_reports`, `power`, `apply`, `publish`, `register`, `serve_bundle`, …), all `ExposureDefinition` data lowered into the one served catalogue; `entities.permissions` parsed + permission-coverage validated at link | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/exposure.rs` |
| `service`/`provider_client` bindings + `subject_kind = client` rule | OAuth client subjects parse only onto `CallerKind::{Service, ProviderClient}`; `human_principal`/`agent` refuse at bind; identity never inferred from payloads | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/binding.rs` · `s5_7::client_subject_binds_only_service_or_provider` |
| Delegate write gate | Write-class tools refuse `DelegateWriteForbidden` for delegates lacking declared permission coverage; covered delegates pass to the kernel's own authority; `serve_bundle` is launch-class, not memory-write | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/dispatch.rs` · `s5_7::{delegate_write_gate_refuses_uncovered_delegates, delegate_write_gate_permission_coverage}` |
| Tasks carrier | Capability negotiation + `-32021` when unnegotiated; `CreateTaskResult`; `tasks/get`/`tasks/update`/`tasks/cancel`; exhaustive run-status fold; `inputResponses[]` → `respond_permission` under the `human_principal` gate; notifications only after the durable row exists | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/tasks.rs` · `s5_7::{tasks_capability_gate_32021, tasks_carrier_create_get_cancel, tasks_update_delegate_gate}` |
| Resources + subscriptions | Templates, `resources/list`/`read`/`subscribe`/`unsubscribe`; ledger-backed binding-scoped reads; `notifications/resources/updated` minted after durable change; the subscription set is a transport/session projection that dies with the binding | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/resources.rs` · `s5_7::{resources_templates_read_subscribe, subscription_dies_with_binding}` |
| `serve_bundle` | Lowers through canonical `lab.serve`; mints a `session_handle`; no alternate serving path; the kernel's own typed refusal surfaces on a bad bundle | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/dispatch.rs` · `s5_7::serve_bundle_wraps_lab_serve` |
| `human_principal` approval channel | `respond_approval` refuses `IllegitimateEndorsement` for every other caller kind (durable refused row); outcome vocabulary maps to `grant`/`deny`/`defer` | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/dispatch.rs` · `launch.rs` |
| Assumption-debt records | `tasks_carrier` + `resource_carrier` required at exposure link (`MissingDebt` on removal) alongside the existing C1 carriers | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/exposure.rs` · `s5_7::resource_carrier_debt_required_at_link` |
| `_meta` discipline | Caller `_meta` decides nothing — forgery in meta fields never confers authority or identity | `crates/hh-mcp-lab/src/dispatch.rs` · `s5_7::meta_forgery_decides_nothing` |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0318** — the projection-client web
surface (D1), attestation as a minted act (D2),
the single-serving-path exposure lowering (D3),
the `subject_kind = client` binding rule (D4),
permission-coverage delegate gating (D5), the
tasks/resources carriers as projections (D6),
response-envelope notification drain (D7), and
nearest-coherent fork presentation (D8).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`tasks.rs`/`resources.rs` compile rounds** —
  ledger access goes through
  `svc.store().events(...)`; status/event lookup,
  imports, signatures, and a mutable-borrow
  ordering in the `serve_bundle` handle mint were
  corrected before the battery landed.
- **Clippy lints in touched files** —
  overindented doc lists in `tasks.rs`, needless
  explicit lifetimes in `tasks.rs`/`resources.rs`,
  `get().is_some()`→`contains_key` in `views.rs`,
  `Iterator::last()`→`next_back()` in
  `ops_c2.rs`; all fixed, the touched-file clippy
  is clean.
- **`s4_11` fixtures** — the shipped exposure
  document gained `resource_carrier`/`tasks_carrier`
  debt records, so pre-existing C1 fixtures that
  construct documents by hand were updated to
  carry the new required rows.
- **The `edit`-tool stale-view anomaly recurred**
  on `views.rs` (the known tooling issue from the
  LEDGER's operational rule) — replacements
  verified by direct byte inspection + clippy;
  all build-memory writes went through the shell.
